newsitem.title: FRANCE: Homeless man said killed after theft yields little.
newsitem.headline: Homeless man said killed after theft yields little.

text.p: Three Frenchmen were remanded in custody on suspicion of murder on Tuesday for allegedly throwing a fellow homeless man into a well when they robbed him and found he had just 12 francs ($2), police said.
The 33-year-old victim, whose name was not disclosed, was found dead last Thursday at the bottom of the well in Nantes, western France.
The three suspects, aged 20 to 25, were turned in by the mother of one of them, who told police that her son "confided in her that he had done something stupid", police said.

The three were alleged to have told investigators they had dragged their victim to a secluded location to rob him. After finding only 12 francs, they threw him in the well and pulled out the rope he could have used to climb out.
